children.name: alias
children.description: Property name to use as entrypoint to the service

children.name: fieldAlias
children.description: alias for deeper nested relationships (e.g. { 'price': 'prices.calculated\_price\_set.amount' })

children.name: args
children.description: Extra arguments to pass to the remoteFetchData callback

children.name: schema
children.description: GraphQL schema for the all module's available entities and fields

children.name: isLink
children.description: If the module is a link module

children.name: linkableKeys
children.description: Keys that can be used to link to other modules. e.g { product\_id: "Product" } "Product" being the entity it refers to

children.name: isReadOnlyLink
children.description: If true it expands a RemoteQuery property but doesn't create a pivot table

children.name: extraDataFields
children.description:
Fields that will be part of the link record aside from the primary keys that can be updated
If not explicitly defined, this array will be populated by databaseConfig.extraFields

children.name: graph
children.description:
Graph function uses the remoteQuery under the hood and
returns a result set

children.name: index
children.description:
Index function uses the index module to query and remoteQuery to hydrate the data
returns a result set

children.name: gql
children.description: Query wrapper to provide specific GraphQL like API around remoteQuery.query

children.name: discoveryPath
children.description:
Explicitly set the true location of the module resources.
Can be used to re-export the module from a different location and specify its original location.

children.name: loaderOnly
children.description: Forces the modules bootstrapper to only run the modules loaders and return prematurely

children.name: migrationOnly
children.description:
Only partially load modules to retrieve their module joiner configs and run their loaders.
Useful for migrations.

children.name: schemaOnly
children.description:
Only partially load modules to retrieve their module joiner configs without running loaders.
Useful for type generation.

blocks.html:
Verify that a database connection can be established before running
migrations. Without this check, a stalled connection (for example, a wrong
database URL or an SSL handshake that never completes) hangs the migrator
indefinitely with no error. This fails fast with an actionable message
instead.

instead.
